values = [3332, 3424, 3657, 3828, 4075, 4234, 4518, 4770, 5045, 5328]

mean = sum(values) / n

# Calculate Theil index using the formula
# T = (1/n) * Σ(y_i / ȳ * ln(y_i / ȳ))
theil_sum = 0
for v in values:
    ratio = v / mean
    theil_sum += ratio * math.log(ratio)

theil_index = theil_sum / n

# Alternative: Calculate using the full formula
# T = (1/n) * Σ (y_i * ln(y_i) - y_i * ln(ȳ))
# This should give the same result
theil_sum_alt = sum(v * math.log(v) for v in values) - n * mean * math.log(mean)
theil_index_alt = theil_sum_alt / (n * mean)

print(f"Theil index (method 1): {theil_index}")
print(f"Theil index (method 2): {theil_index_alt}")

# Now check with natural log - both should be the same since we're using same base
print(f"\nFinal Theil index (rounded to 3 decimal places): {round(theil_index, 3)}")

# Verify manually for one value
print(f"\nManual verification:")
for v in values:
    ratio = v / mean
    term = ratio * math.log(ratio)
    print(f"  {v}: ratio={ratio:.6f}, ln(ratio)={math.log(ratio):.6f}, term={term:.6f}")
print(f"  Sum: {theil_sum:.6f}")
print(f"  T = {theil_sum:.6f}/{n} = {theil_index:.6f}")
